meta.title: Pip's Alphabet Adventures
meta.subtitle: ABC Learning and Letter Tracing Book for Toddlers, Ages 2 to 8
meta.tagline: Come discover every letter with Pip the fox.

back.headline: A letter adventure with Pip
back.blurb: From A to Z, Pip the fox climbs, plays, and discovers a new word on every page. Trace the giant letters, find Pip in the pictures, play matching games, and share a fun fact together — perfect for bedtime, car rides, and first readers.
bullets: Trace, match, find, and write-with-Pip games
Certificate to celebrate finishing the alphabet
back.closing: Open the cover. Meet Pip. Start the adventure.

front.copyright_line: A picture-book alphabet for curious little readers.
front.belongs_note: Pip is so glad you came along.
front.meet_body: This is Pip, a small fox with a very big curiosity. Pip climbs letters, tastes apples, flies kites, and asks a hundred questions. On every page, Pip is discovering something new — and so are you.
front.meet_prompt: Can you find Pip on every letter?
front.how_intro: Read it together. Point, play, and pause. There is no wrong way.

how_steps.title: Look
how_steps.text: Point to the giant letter. Trace it with a finger.

how_steps.title: Say
how_steps.text: Say the sound, then say the word out loud.

how_steps.title: Find Pip
how_steps.text: Where is Pip hiding this time? What is Pip doing?

how_steps.title: Discover
how_steps.text: Look at the big picture. Talk about the fun fact together.

letters.fact: An apple is a crunchy fruit that grows on a tree.
letters.action: Pip takes a happy bite of a shiny red apple.

letters.fact: A ball is round, so it can bounce, roll, and fly.
letters.action: Pip bounces a big striped ball across the grass.

letters.fact: A cat purrs when it feels safe and cozy.
letters.action: Pip plays gently with a fluffy little cat.

letters.fact: A dog wags its tail to say hello.
letters.action: Pip wraps the puppy in a warm hug.

letters.fact: A bird egg is a tiny home until the chick is ready.
letters.action: Pip discovers a speckled egg tucked in a nest.

letters.fact: A fish breathes in water using gills, not lungs.
letters.action: Pip watches a goldfish shimmer in the pond.

letters.fact: A goat is a great climber and loves to nibble grass.
letters.action: Pip shares a tuft of grass with a friendly goat.

letters.fact: A hat keeps the sun off your face and rain off your head.
letters.action: Pip tries on a hat that is comically too big.

letters.fact: An igloo is a snug snow house that can feel surprisingly warm.
letters.action: Pip sits beside a little igloo in the quiet snow.

letters.fact: Juice is a drink squeezed from fruit — orange juice comes from oranges.
letters.action: Pip sips sweet juice through a striped straw.

letters.fact: A kite flies when the wind lifts it and you hold the string.
letters.action: Pip runs with a kite dancing in the sky.

letters.fact: A leaf catches sunlight so a tree can make its food.
letters.action: Pip catches a falling autumn leaf.

letters.fact: The moon is Earth’s neighbor in space, and it lights up the night.
letters.action: Pip sits on a hill and gazes at the great gold moon.

letters.fact: A nest is a soft cup that birds build to keep eggs safe.
letters.action: Pip looks up at a nest tucked in a tree.

letters.fact: An owl can turn its head almost all the way around.
letters.action: Pip sits quietly with a round, wise owl.

letters.fact: A penguin is a bird that swims instead of flying.
letters.action: Pip waddles across the ice with a penguin friend.

letters.fact: A quilt is a blanket sewn from many cozy pieces.
letters.action: Pip snuggles into a patchwork quilt.

letters.fact: A rainbow appears when sunlight shines through raindrops.
letters.action: Pip points up at a bright, quiet rainbow.

letters.fact: The sun is a star, and its light helps plants, animals, and people grow.
letters.action: Pip soaks up the warmth of a smiling sun.

letters.fact: A tree drinks water through its roots and makes shade with its leaves.
letters.action: Pip rests in the cool shade of a friendly tree.

letters.fact: An umbrella is a little roof you can carry when it rains.
letters.action: Pip holds a big umbrella in a gentle rain.

letters.fact: A violin makes music when a bow dances across its strings.
letters.action: Pip plays a wooden violin with great concentration.

letters.fact: A whale is a huge animal that lives in the ocean and breathes air.
letters.action: Pip rides on the back of a gentle giant whale.

letters.fact: A xylophone sings when you tap its colorful bars.
letters.action: Pip taps a rainbow xylophone, one note at a time.

letters.fact: A yo-yo spins down a string and can climb right back up.
letters.action: Pip sends a yo-yo bouncing down and up again.

letters.fact: Every zebra’s stripes are as unique as a fingerprint.
letters.action: Pip stands proudly beside a striped zebra friend.

activities.tracing_intro: Start at the top. Go slowly. Pip is not in a hurry.
activities.review_intro: Point to each letter. Can you say its sound?
activities.review_prompt: Grown-ups: name a letter. Little readers: find it!
activities.matching_intro: Draw a line from each letter to the picture that belongs with it.
activities.match_pip_intro: Pip is busy on every page! Draw a line from each letter to Pip’s picture.
activities.find_intro: Circle the letter Pip is looking for.
activities.sequence_intro: Say the letters out loud. Write the missing one in the empty box.
activities.odd_intro: Circle the picture that belongs with each letter.
activities.write_intro: Trace each letter, then write it again in the empty boxes.
activities.bonus_intro: Draw Pip here. Trace a favorite letter. Invent a brand-new word!

certificate.title: I learned my alphabet!
certificate.body: This certifies that a very brave letter explorer finished the whole alphabet with Pip the fox.
certificate.closing: The End — for now. Tomorrow there are more words to find.
